title: Cell-Penetrating Penta-Peptides (CPP5s): Measurement of Cell Entry and Protein-Transduction Activity

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DRAMP34806/VPTLK has source support for VPTLK/Fam-VPTLK CPP5 identity and N-terminal Fam experimental context, but the linked DRAMP Antimicrobial/Anticancer labels have no matching primary antimicrobial, MIC, hemolysis, cancer-cell killing, or anticancer assay in the reopened article. Those rows remain source_conflict; the citation link is source_verified.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered source-supported cell-penetration, low cytotoxicity, cytoprotective, LC-MS/MS uptake, and protein-transduction rows from XML/PDF prose and figure captions. No database-only antimicrobial/MIC row was promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are limited to cell-entry pathway evidence and explicit absence of antimicrobial/anticancer mechanism assays; the paper itself leaves the complete CPP5 entry mechanism unresolved.
per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material extraction remains complete-with-gaps only because there are no local supplementary assets. The OA package contains NXML/PDF/figures and was sufficient for this worker-2/4/6 adjudication.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Structural packet/validator readiness is separate from source-reviewed publication-grade acceptance; acceptance here rests on repaired semantic artifacts and preserved database conflicts.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP labels VPTLK/Bip2 as Antimicrobial and Anticancer, but the primary paper supports cell penetration, cytoprotection, low cytotoxicity, and protein transduction rather than antimicrobial or anticancer killing assays.
No MIC/MBC/MFC/hemolysis/microbial target rows are present in XML/PDF/OA/package/database snapshots for this paper.

Some exact figure-panel values are embedded only in local figure images; worker-2 recorded text/caption-supported qualitative, significance, and range-level results and did not fabricate numeric image readings.
Packet, landed root, and OA package contain no separate supplementary files beyond the NXML/PDF/figure assets.

summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair recovered CPP5 cell-entry, cytotoxicity, cytoprotection, uptake, and protein-transduction evidence from local XML/PDF/OA materials, while preserving DRAMP34806 antimicrobial/anticancer labels as source conflicts. The paper is publication-grade with cautions and no open rework targets.
